name: IStochastic_Trading
summary: This EA trades based on the Stochastic Oscillator, entering buy positions when the indicator is oversold and sell positions when overbought. It uses customizable Stochastic parameters (%K, %D, slowing) along with configurable lot sizing, stop loss, and take profit levels. The strategy follows a classic mean reversion approach, expecting price to revert from extreme Stochastic readings.
summary_zh: 该EA基于随机指标（Stochastic Oscillator）进行交易，在指标超卖时做多，超买时做空。它使用可配置的Stochastic参数（%K、%D、减速）以及可自定义的手数、止损和止盈水平。策略遵循经典的均值回归方法，预期价格从极端Stochastic读数回归。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于Stochastic震荡指标的经典均值回归交易。入场条件为：当%K线和%D线从超卖区域（低于20）向上交叉时开多单，当%K线和%D线从超买区域（高于80）向下交叉时开空单。出场条件依赖预设的固定止损和止盈水平，也可能在反向信号出现时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户通过参数指定交易手数，没有根据账户余额动态调整的机制。资金管理方面较为简单，止损和止盈为固定点数设置，缺乏基于ATR或波动率的动态风险管理。整体策略逻辑清晰但缺乏对市场趋势环境的过滤，可能在趋势行情中频繁逆势交易导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is classic mean reversion trading based on the Stochastic Oscillator. Entry conditions are: open a buy position when the %K and %D lines cross upward from the oversold zone (below 20), and open a sell position when they cross downward from the overbought zone (above 80). Exit conditions rely on preset fixed stop loss and take profit levels, and positions may also be closed when an opposing signal appears. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user specifies the trade volume via a parameter, with no dynamic adjustment mechanism based on account balance. Money management is relatively simple, with stop loss and take profit set as fixed pip values, lacking dynamic risk management based on ATR or volatility. The overall strategy logic is clear but lacks a trend environment filter, which may lead to frequent counter-trend trades and consecutive losses during trending markets.
pros: 策略逻辑清晰简洁，基于经典技术指标，易于理解和验证
使用Stochastic超买超卖区域过滤信号，减少虚假入场
设有止损和止盈，具备基本的风险控制机制
pros_en: Clear and concise strategy logic based on a classic technical indicator, easy to understand and verify
Uses Stochastic overbought/oversold zones to filter signals, reducing false entries
Includes stop loss and take profit settings, providing basic risk control
cons: 缺乏趋势过滤器，在强趋势行情中容易逆势交易造成连续亏损
固定手数和固定止损止盈，未根据市场波动率动态调整
未检查是否已存在同方向持仓，可能导致重复开仓增加风险敞口
未进行新K线检查，同一根K线上可能多次触发信号导致过度交易
cons_en: Lacks a trend filter, prone to counter-trend trading and consecutive losses in strong trending markets
Fixed lot size and fixed SL/TP without dynamic adjustment based on market volatility
Does not check for existing same-direction positions, potentially leading to duplicate entries and increased risk exposure
No new bar check, signals may trigger multiple times on the same bar causing over-trading
improvements: 添加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或更高周期趋势判断），避免在强趋势中逆势交易
实现基于ATR的动态止损止盈和仓位管理，根据市场波动率自适应调整风险参数
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction or higher timeframe trend assessment) to avoid counter-trend trades in strong trends
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss/take profit and position sizing to adapt risk parameters to market volatility

risk_points: 均值回归策略在趋势行情中可能产生连续亏损
未做新K线检查和持仓检查，存在过度交易和重复开仓风险
risk_points_en: Mean reversion strategy may produce consecutive losses in trending markets
No new bar check and no position check, creating risk of over-trading and duplicate entries

The strategy follows a classic mean reversion approach, expecting price to revert from extreme Stochastic readings.
